payload.title: Guardrails page links to Learning-Tactus chapters 12-14, which return 404
payload.description:
**Problem**
https://tactus.anth.us/guardrails/ links to three Learning-Tactus chapters that 404.

**Evidence**
guardrails.md:265-267. Re-checked 2026-10-20: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://anthusai.github.io/Learning-Tactus/chapters/12-threat-modeling-and-guardrails/` returns 404 (chapters 13-sandboxing-layers-lua-vm-and-containers and 14-secretless-execution likewise).

**Fix**
Publish chapters 12-14 in Learning-Tactus, or update the links to the real chapter URLs, or remove them.

**How to verify**
All three URLs in guardrails.md:265-267 return 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
